state.name: readings
state.description: Every instrument reading Lira logs. One entry per reading. method is hand, relay or cipher; status is ok, error, forged, restored, doubted or misclassified. A node counts as verified only if its latest entry has method hand or cipher and status ok or restored.

state.name: margin_notes
state.description: The eight notes in another hand, and what the player did with each: ignored, circled, answered, acted, or answered-and-acted. The unsigned clandestine note of Book II is not one of them.

state.name: nodes_verified
state.description: How many of the twelve nodes N1 to N12 have a verified reading right now. N12 can never be verified, so the maximum is 11. Recomputed from readings whenever readings changes.

state.name: verified_share
state.description: The share of the twelve node inputs to the final model that were verified by hand, in percent: round(nodes_verified / 12 * 100). Frozen at the end of The Key III, before the descent. 60 or more (8 nodes) is a condition of The Archivist in Time.

state.name: margin_notes_answered
state.description: How many of the eight margin notes the player wrote a reply beside (0 to 8). 6 or more is a condition of The Archivist in Time.

state.name: margin_notes_acted
state.description: How many margin notes the player acted on (re-sampled, re-checked, re-measured). Acting on note 1 corrects N1, note 4 marks a forgery in Journal Audit II, note 5 fixes N10, and note 7 highlights the damping test.

state.name: exposure
state.description: How visible Lira is to the Continuum. +10 publish note, +15 publish brief, +15 broadcast, +5 per margin reply, -3 per relay reading. At 40 or more, Journal Audit II gets two extra forgeries; at 70 or more, outpost and vault patrols double.

state.name: relay_used
state.description: How many node readings were taken from the Continuum relay beacons instead of by hand.

state.name: gear_tier
state.description: Climbing gear, 0 to 3. Sets the highest band Lira can work in and how long her air lasts in the cross-section climb.

state.name: pattern_alpha
state.description: Lira has recorded and named Pattern alpha in the Spore-Weaver valley.

state.name: fragment_salvaged
state.description: Lira has the crystalline fragment from the storm-struck outpost.

state.name: hypothesis_1
state.description: Hypothesis 1 is written in the journal.

state.name: note_published
state.description: Lira published her cautious note at the end of Book I.

state.name: seeding_evidence
state.description: The Assay II found non-natural isotope ratios.

state.name: veylor_named
state.description: The sealed archive has given up the names Dr. Solace Veylor and Operation ReGenesis.

state.name: brief_redacted
state.description: Lira's technical brief has been published and surgically redacted.

state.name: key_branches_added
state.description: New couplets the player has written into the dichotomous key when an anomaly broke it.

state.name: cipher_nodes_decoded
state.description: Nodes located correctly from songs and chants (N7 to N10), 0 to 4.

state.name: forgeries_caught
state.description: Altered or forged entries the player found in Journal Audits I and II.

state.name: forgeries_missed
state.description: Altered or forged entries the player let stand.

state.name: false_accusations
state.description: True entries in Lira's own hand that the player struck as forged.

state.name: second_genesis_proof
state.description: Lira escaped the subterranean city with the logs that prove the Second Genesis.

state.name: broadcast_sent
state.description: Lira broadcast her raw data dump to the settlements from the hideout.

state.name: joren_forgiven
state.description: Lira took Joren back into the coalition in Book IV. Gives the eighth emitter and the Retune action.

state.name: emitters_available
state.description: Emitters for the Node Board II: 7, plus 1 if Joren is forgiven; the timing crystal from Under the lens III must be found or the count drops by 1.

state.name: home_terrace_held
state.description: The terrace drill on the Node Board brought Hollin Terrace's network under the calm line. Also verifies node N11.

state.name: gamma_remeasured
state.description: Lira measured the damping herself in The Assay III, so the Node Board II shows the true calm line instead of the Continuum's.

state.name: core_choice
state.description: What Lira does at the end of the Node Board II.

state.name: terraces_held
state.description: Terrace districts held when the pulses fire: one per damped node among N1 to N11, so 0 to 11; by design never 11.

state.name: pages_restored
state.description: Redacted passages the archivist restores in Journal Audit III, 0 to 12.

state.name: names_protected
state.description: The archivist left every living person's name under the black bar.

state.name: book_closed
state.description: At the last page the player chose to close the book rather than keep going.
